Title: Measure it yourself with two loads and a watt meter
Description: On an ENERGY STAR dishwasher, heated dry costs under about 10¢ a load at 17–18¢ per kWh. The math behind that ceiling, and a two-load test to measure your own.

Title: Why disinfecting wipes don't belong on stainless steel
Description: Mostly no. Mild soap, glass cleaner, and a disinfectant cover most homes. Marble, wood floors, glass cooktops, and leather are the real exceptions.

Title: Sweet onions keep months longer in a crisper
Description: Onions sprout anywhere from 41 to 68°F and garlic from 40 to 64°F, which covers most pantries. What sprouts, roots, and mold each mean, and where to store bulbs.

Title: A coffee mug of salt treats about 10 sidewalk squares
Description: The dead strip is de-icing salt. Rock salt quits at 15°F, so cold-day salting lands in the grass. Doses, de-icer temperatures, and a repair schedule.
Keywords: lawn care, fall and winter yard, outdoor maintenance

Title: What a plumber or electrician costs in 2026
Description: Call a pro for gas, panel, structural, and hidden-water problems. If you can shut a problem off safely, it can often wait for weekday rates. 2026 costs and the math.
